findings.problem: SubagentStop requires no unused permit, but renewal after every complete child PostToolBatch leaves an unused permit when the child finishes immediately after its tool batch.
findings.reachable_trigger: Installed-Qwen captures r2/r3 show child Pre/Post → inner PostToolBatch → SubagentStop with no child continuation request. Refusing renewal breaks r4b, while issuing it makes the observed r2/r3 Stop fail.
findings.repair: Represent batch renewal as a single revocable continuation authorization. The next child dispatch may consume it, or a matching SubagentStop may atomically revoke it after complete child accounting. Audit both outcomes and add the no-continuation-after-inner-batch case.
